decisions.reason: The beige marking on green dispense buttons does not change the machine's DJ-turntable-inspired visual identity.
The source specifies the color of the cursive K on dispense buttons, not the machine name, placard wording, placement, or sides.
Changing the button marking color does not alter press-to-dispense interaction, valve operation, or dispensing behavior.
Button marking color has no effect on bowl capacity, size, or form.
The source concerns button marking color and does not change spout geometry, construction, appearance, or orientation.
The button marking color is a visual-design detail and does not change the system-layout or CAD deliverable state.
Button marking color does not affect mixing quality, foam, texture, or high-speed mixing behavior.
The source makes no change to the required electrical wiring plan.
The color of the button marking does not change splash targets, guards, or high-speed mitigation measures.
Button marking color does not affect bowl removal, swapping, clearance, or cleaning access.
The source selects a visual marking color but does not revise component selection, purchasing status, or BOM deliverables.
Button marking color has no effect on plumbing seals, leak prevention, or liquid containment.
